sentimento.text1: The distance between LULA and FLÁVIO BOLSONARO narrowed for a FIFTH straight day and closed at 30.45pp on the confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC). It was 37.05pp on Aug 16, 33.05pp on the 17th, 31.45pp on the 18th, 30.95pp on the 19th and 30.65pp on the 20th: 6.60pp in five days.
sentimento.text2: ⭐ And the source of the move changed midway through the sequence. Of the 6.60pp, 3.00pp came off the leader, all of it between Aug 16 and 18, and 3.60pp came from the runner-up. Lula repeated 63.50% for a FOURTH straight day and Flávio Bolsonaro rose 0.20pp to 33.05%. ⛔ And it is not a record: in the series of 174 readings since May 23, only 2 print 33.05% or above, and both are 33.20%, from Jun 2 and Aug 18.
sentimento.text3: ⭐⭐ THE STORY OF THE DAY IS TWO POLLS THAT CONTRADICT EACH OTHER. The DATAFOLHA (n=2,058, field Aug 18 to 20, BR-04496/2026, reliability 5) gives Lula 39% x Flávio Bolsonaro 32% in the scenario with Pablo Marçal, and Lula 47% x Flávio 43% in the runoff. The VERITÁ (n=3,840, field Aug 16 to 20, reliability 2), released hours earlier, gives a 0.2 point tie in the first round and INVERTS the runoff, with Flávio at 47.3% against 42%. That is more than 9 points of difference in the runoff between institutes with overlapping fieldwork. ⭐ Marçal was measured by both, at 2% and 5.2%, while the price pays 0.15% on him. The panel publishes both and declares the ruler behind each one.
sentimento.direita: The runner-up rose 0.20pp, from 32.85% to 33.05% (vol USD 8.72M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC), a fifth straight day narrowing the distance. ⭐ AT THE BALLOT he is where the two national polls of the day disagree most: the Datafolha gives him 32% in the first round and 43% in the runoff; the Veritá gives him 39.1% and 47.3%. ⚠️ There is no new confirmed reading on Aug 21 for the second place contract, which stands at 87.50% since Aug 20.
sentimento.esquerda: The leader repeated 63.50% for a FOURTH straight day (vol USD 8.80M accumulated), confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC). The series high is 67.50%, from Aug 16. ⭐ AT THE BALLOT, the two national polls of the day disagree about his distance to the runner-up: the Datafolha measures 7 points in the first round (39% x 32%) and 4 in the runoff (47% x 43%); the Veritá measures 0.2 point in the first round and puts him BEHIND in the runoff, 42% against 47.3%.
sentimento.terceiraVia: ⭐ A NEW NAME ENTERED THE COUNT, THROUGH BOTH POLLS OF THE DAY AND WITH DIFFERENT RESULTS: Pablo Marçal has 2% at Datafolha and 5.2% at Veritá. 🔴 In price he has 0.15% (vol USD 2.20M), Renan Santos 4.30% (vol USD 10.46M) and Ronaldo Caiado 0.45% (vol USD 6.42M). ⚠️ All three sit below the 0.5% floor the double reading confirms, and the quantities do not subtract: the panel records that ballot and price order the field differently.
sentimento.polymarket: Confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC). Lula 63.50%, Flávio Bolsonaro 33.05%, Renan Santos 4.30%, Ronaldo Caiado 0.45% and Pablo Marçal 0.15%. The presidential book has accumulated USD 130.58M.

inss.text1: ⭐ NEW DEVELOPMENT ON Aug 20, AND IT COMES FROM THE PROSECUTION. The Prosecutor General's Office stated that the man known as the "Careca do INSS" did not close deals with the Lula government and pointed to imprecision in a Federal Police conclusion, according to Estadão, in a petition sent to Justice André Mendonça.
inss.text2: On the same day the case became litigation between the two sides of the race: Fábio Luís Lula da Silva sued Flávio Bolsonaro and sought damages over a video made with artificial intelligence about suspected diversions, according to O Globo, Aug 20. Earlier on Aug 20, Flávio cited the case and treated the Dark Horse episode as a closed chapter, according to Folha.
inss.text3: The distinction this panel has kept from the start still holds: the effect on how the administration is rated is one thing, the effect on voting intention is another. ⛔ The panel does NOT attribute the 6.40pp narrowing over four days to the case, because no measurement isolates that.
inss.text4: ⭐ A NEW GOVERNMENT RATING, in the Datafolha of Aug 21: 47% approve and 50% disapprove, against 49% and 48% in July. Electoral rejection in the same round is 46% for Flávio Bolsonaro and 45% for Lula, and 72% say they are decided on their vote. ⚠️ The BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 measured 42% poor or terrible and 34% great or good, on a different scale, and the two do not compare directly. ⛔ The panel still does not publish numbers from internal party polls, which have no registration and no open methodology.
inss.impactoLula: Not isolable, and now with two measurements from the same day that disagree: the Datafolha puts him at 39% in the first round with a 7 point lead, and the Veritá at 39.3% with 0.2 point. ⛔ Neither isolates the effect of the case, and the panel does not attribute the price move to it.
inss.impactoGestao: The rating still carries a negative balance: 42% poor or very poor against 34% excellent or good in the BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 (n=2,003, field Aug 14 to 16, TSE registration BR-03317/2026), a distance of 8 points. The panel records the balance and does not project an electoral effect from it.
inss.conclusao: On Aug 20 the case gained two new layers of different natures: the Prosecutor General's Office contested part of the Federal Police's conclusion, and the president's son went to court against his opponent over content generated with artificial intelligence. It remains without a judicial outcome, and the panel converts neither into voting intention.

bancoMaster.text1: ⭐ THE NEW DEVELOPMENT ON Aug 20 IS ABOUT A PLEA DEAL. Investigators are willing to reopen negotiations with Daniel Vorcaro, but demand a complete plea agreement and a precise listing of assets held abroad, according to Folha de S.Paulo.
bancoMaster.text2: On the same day his defence asked to postpone his testimony to the Federal Police, citing a new lawyer joining the team, according to O Globo. ⚠️ The case also entered the campaign by another route: Justice André Mendonça, at the TSE, ordered the removal of a video made with artificial intelligence linking Flávio Bolsonaro to Vorcaro, and recorded that satire does not lift the prohibition. Reported independently by O Globo and G1, both on Aug 20.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The panel keeps the two things apart on purpose. Negotiating a plea deal is an investigative step and is not a conviction, and the case remains without a judicial outcome. Removing the video is an electoral ruling about campaign advertising, not a judgment on the merits of the banking case.
bancoMaster.conclusao: On Aug 20 the case produced movement on two fronts: plea negotiations were reopened with a demand for assets abroad, and the Electoral Court ordered the takedown of a campaign piece using Vorcaro's name against the runner-up. It remains unresolved.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act captured on Aug 20.
stf.moraes: ⚠️ He appears on Aug 20 in a criticism of method, not in a new act: a Folha column that day records a series of errors by him and by Dino in a case involving a journalist from Maranhão.
stf.gilmar: No new individual act on Aug 20.
stf.dino: No new individual act on Aug 20. He appears in the same Folha column cited above, alongside Moraes.
stf.mendonca: ⭐ THE MOST PRESENT JUSTICE OF THE DAY, AND IN BOTH ROLES. As a Supreme Court justice, he intends to use the court's precedents to keep the investigations into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva under his purview (Folha, Aug 20). As a TSE justice, he ordered the removal of the artificial intelligence video linking Flávio Bolsonaro to Daniel Vorcaro (O Globo and G1, Aug 20).
stf.nexo: ⭐ THE THROUGH-LINE ON Aug 20 IS ONE NAME IN TWO SEATS. André Mendonça rules, on the same day, on the case touching the son of the man leading the polls and on the campaign piece targeting the runner-up. 📌 The panel records the institutional coincidence and does NOT attribute intent to it: these are distinct jurisdictions, one at the Supreme Court and one at the Electoral Court, exercised by the same person. ⚠️ And the impeachment contract reacted to none of it.
stf.analise: Contract on the impeachment of a supreme court justice, confirmed reading of Aug 21, 3:59 PM BRT (6:59 PM UTC): 3.35% (vol USD 84 thousand), unchanged from Aug 20. 📌 The book is small, USD 84 thousand accumulated, and a move of that size in it does not support a trend reading.
